title: Collective alignment: public input on our Model Spec
summary: OpenAI surveyed over 1,000 people worldwide on how AI should behave and compared their views to our Model Spec. Learn how collective alignment is shaping AI defaults to better reflect diverse human values and perspectives.
body: OpenAI surveyed over 1,000 people worldwide on how AI should behave and compared their views to our Model Spec. Learn how collective alignment is shaping AI defaults to better reflect diverse human values and perspectives.
summaryZh: OpenAI展示了针对模型行为规范（Model Spec）的全球集体对齐调研成果，该调研收集了全球1000多名受访者的意见，并将其与现有模型规范进行对比，旨在使AI系统的默认行为能更好地反映多元化的人类价值观和视角。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI公布了基于全球公众调研的集体对齐结果，探讨如何通过公众意见改进Model Spec模型行为规范。

glossary.explanationZh: OpenAI制定的用于规范模型行为和价值观输出的指导方针文档。
通过广泛收集公众多元观点来对齐人工智能行为偏好的方法。
